title: Classify occurrence records by positional uncertainty relative to an analysis grain — ingrain
text: "inert" – \(r \le R/2\). uncertainty disc's diameter exceed one cell edge, uncertainty-aware correction meaningfully act: covariate effectively constant region record occupy. "marginal" – \(R/2 < r \le 3R\). boundary band, whether positional error matters depends record falls relative cell boundaries local covariate variation. "actionable" – \(r > 3R\). uncertainty region spans many cells; corrections (threshold filtering, near-geographic near-environmental point methods, change support) room act, choice among consequences. "unreported" – \(r\) NA. correction can act, radius recovered coordinates . Boundary handling inclusive mirrors, bit bit, cumulative-threshold construction used compute published partition (counts records \(r \le u\) \(u = R/2\) \(u = 3R\), differences): radius exactly \(R/2\) inert, exactly \(3R\) marginal. NaN counts NA. "inert" state operationalises observation made passing Hefley et al. (2017): change--support correction act covariate constant within raster cell. Negative infinite radii raise error; values data defects screened upstream (e.g. CoordinateCleaner bdc). ingrain() deliberately performs cleaning: classifies correction filter data resolution.
